summary: Allows DNSSEC-validating resolvers to use NSEC and NSEC3 records from cache to generate negative answers for whole ranges of names, and positive answers from wildcards. This can improve speed, reduce load, and increase privacy. It updates RFC 4035 and is updated by RFC 9077.

eli5.summary: Instead of asking again whether a name exists, a resolver uses its notes that nothing lives between two names, and answers right away.
